awake.en: It's called Stroke. You're awake And trying to grasp who it is.
awake.zh: 它叫《中风》。你醒着，试图弄清楚这是谁。

award.en: He then awards the business the contract to build a bridge or a road.
award.zh: 然后他就会把建造桥梁或道路的合同判给这家企业。

award.en: One of the most prestigious awards in computing, the Turing Award, is named in his honor.
award.zh: 计算机领域最负盛名的奖项之一——Turing Award，便是以他的名字命名的。

award.en: One of the most prestigious awards in computing, the Turing Award, is named in his honor.
award.zh: 计算机领域最负盛名的奖项之一——Turing Award，便是以他的名字命名的。

award.en: The top prizes for any professional chef are Michelin stars, awards given to restaurants offering outstanding cooking.
award.zh: 对任何职业厨师来说，最高荣誉就是米其林星级，这是颁发给提供杰出烹饪的餐厅的奖项。

award.en: There are many types of corruption. Politicians might award a mining contract to their friend or family members.
award.zh: 腐败有多种类型。政客可能会将采矿合同授予他们的朋友或家庭成员。

awful.en: Then I listened to them again and…I thought they sounded awful.
awful.zh: 然后我回听了一下……我觉得听起来糟透了。

awful.en: He was also an awful drunk and was seen as a liability.
awful.zh: 他也是个臭名昭著的酒鬼，被视为一种累赘。

awful.en: And I felt awful walking back past the kitchen on my way out.
awful.zh: 我走出去时，走过厨房都觉得糟透了。

awful.en: He said that " desecration is awful" and that his government was " committed to tackling all forms of hatred and division."
awful.zh: 他表示“亵渎是可怕的”，并且他的政府“致力于打击一切形式的仇恨和分裂”。

awful.en: Yes, Blackwater contractors clearly did awful things in Iraq, but the ongoing conduct of Wagner soldiers is in another league.
awful.zh: 是的，黑水公司的承包商在伊拉克显然做过可怕的事情，但瓦格纳士兵一贯的行为完全是另一个级别的。

awkward.en: Others will have said 20:30… or 21:00… or later because it is awkward to arrive too early.
awkward.zh: 另一些人则会说八点半……或者九点……甚至更晚，因为到得太早会很尴尬。

awkward.en: And in your personal life, knowing euphemisms can avoid some awkward moments.
awkward.zh: 在你的个人生活中，了解委婉语可以避免一些尴尬的时刻。

awkward.en: In some cases, arriving too early can be rude and arriving too early can be awkward.
awkward.zh: 在某些情况下，到得太早反而才是不礼貌的，而且会很尴尬。

awkward.en: If I sound slightly unnatural or awkward using those slang terms, it’s because it is unnatural.
awkward.zh: 如果我使用这些俚语时听起来有点不自然或尴尬，那是因为它们本来就不自然。

awkward.en: They want agreement, and if the other person disagrees, the conversation can quickly become awkward or defensive.
awkward.zh: 他们想要的是认同，如果对方不同意，对话很快就会变得尴尬或充满防守意味。
